input.quote: 6. DOCUMENTATION AND DISPUTES. Client will be provided upon request with documentation supporting the amount charged (other than the minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4) and will be entitled to contest any charge
input.rationale: Searches for audit/inspection/verification/records/books/premises/monitoring return no vendor audit or usage-verification right binding Client, and the two likely homes (§5 Compensation/§6 Documentation and Disputes and §8 Client Covenants) contain none: §6 runs in our favour (TrueLink must supply supporting documentation and we may contest charges), and §8 imposes only substantive covenants with no inspection mechanic. The only access language is at §8(f)/p0058 (technical anti-spam mechanisms) and p0060 (access for TrueLink to make Y2K repairs at its own cost), neither of which is an audit of our usage or records. Since no audit right is asserted against us, there is nothing to limit and nothing exceeding the walk-away position (no unlimited, unannounced or remote-access audits); the absence benefits our party, so we do not insert frequency/notice/cost limits that would create an audit right where none exists.
